# core Agent Guide

## Task Route

- Run the build, test and strict formatting checks in `README.md#development`
  before handoff.
- For workflow changes, run `actionlint` on every workflow.
- Community files and templates are organization defaults in
  `agents-tools/.github`; this repository keeps `CODEOWNERS`, the Dependabot
  configuration and workflow callers under `.github/`.

## Module Boundaries

- Keep each target's responsibilities, dependencies and access levels as
  `Documentation/Architecture/Package.md` states, and update it with the
  dependency graph in `Package.swift`.
- Keep package-domain prefixes out of internal target names unless the package
  boundary stops making that context clear.
- Disable automatic maintenance and gc in fixture Git repositories.

## Package Route

- Read `README.md` and, when present, `CONTRIBUTING.md` before editing, and
  follow the organization
  [maintenance change flow](https://github.com/agents-tools/.github/blob/master/MAINTENANCE.md#change-flow).
- Before changing versions, dependencies, packaging or release workflows, read
  the organization [VERSIONING](https://github.com/agents-tools/.github/blob/master/VERSIONING.md)
  and `Documentation/Reference/Release.md`.
- `.github/swift-package.json` configures package validation; the required
  checks are `policy / policy` and `validate / result`. Keep shared workflow
  callers pinned to one full commit of agents-tools/github-workflows.
- Read toolchain and deployment minimums from `Package.swift` and
  `.github/swift-package.json` instead of restating them.
- Read `Documentation/README.md` before placing documentation and
  `Documentation/Architecture/README.md` before changing package structure.

## Test Isolation

- Run tests with an isolated `HOME` and with `CODEX_HOME`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`
  and the `XDG_*` variables unset; never inherit agent or Git configuration.
- Create Git fixtures with an explicit initial branch, and remove every
  fixture and temporary directory a test creates.
